blockers.description: Meta Business Manager verification is pending. Blocks the geknee-meta MCP from being wired (no instagram_content_publish or ads_management scopes until verification clears).
blockers.workaround: Use ig-poster (browser-use + CDP) for posting until verification clears. ig-poster does NOT manage ad campaigns — only feed posts.

blockers.description: macOS native file picker (NSOpenPanel) is OS-level, not DOM. browser-use cannot drive it through CDP. AppleScript via osascript can (Cmd+Shift+G shortcut).
blockers.workaround: Either (a) AppleScript-drive the picker, (b) have post.py find the hidden <input type='file'> and setInputFiles via CDP directly bypassing the picker, or (c) user clicks manually. Today's run used (a) — outcome unverified.

blockers.description: Recent Chrome versions silently ignore --remote-debugging-port on the default Chrome profile (anti-credential-theft policy). DevToolsActivePort file never gets written.
blockers.workaround: Use a dedicated profile dir. launch-chrome.sh now points at ~/.gekneetravel-chrome-data instead of the default profile. User must log into IG in this Chrome ONCE — cookies persist for future runs.

human_actions_pending.action: Grant Accessibility permission to the terminal app (System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Accessibility) so future AppleScript calls to System Events succeed.

decisions.decision: Use ig-poster (browser-use + CDP attach) instead of waiting for Meta verification to unblock posting.
decisions.rationale: Meta Business verification is days-to-weeks. Browser-use against the user's real logged-in Chrome (with hardened agent prompt + ≤2 posts/day cadence) is the lowest-risk workaround. Higher detection risk than API, but acceptable for posting frequency and brand size.

decisions.decision: Use a dedicated Chrome profile dir (~/.gekneetravel-chrome-data) instead of the default profile.
decisions.rationale: Recent Chrome blocks --remote-debugging-port on the default profile. Dedicated profile restores CDP; one-time manual login persists in cookies.

decisions.decision: Default to v5-appicon for IG profile pic, then user overrode to /brand/geknee-mascot.jpg (the canonical mascot used by AtlasShell, GenieCharacters, GenieCharacter, GlobalChat).
decisions.rationale: User chose ad-to-app consistency over thumbnail crispness. Hand-drawn mascot matches what users see in the live app.

decisions.decision: Caption pool delivered at ~/geknee/ad-assets/captions.md with 3 variants per audience (V1/V2/V3) — daily skill rotates per audience to keep feed fresh.
decisions.rationale: IG and Andromeda both penalize identical captions across posts. V1/V2/V3 cycle gives ~3 weeks per audience before repetition.

decisions.decision: Generated 6 audience-targeted statics (A1-A6) plus 2 real-app composites (gk-ad-real-1-globe.png, gk-ad-real-2-planner.png) instead of 12 mixed.
decisions.rationale: Andromeda creative-as-targeting rubric rewards concept/format/visual/hook/headline diversity. 6 distinct audiences = LOW Entity-ID cluster risk. Real-app ads carry highest ad-to-app trust.
